Service Provider Agreement

Terms and Conditions

Please read before signing up as a service provider.

1. Payment split. For every job you complete, 20% goes to TeenTastic Turf (admin) and you keep 80%. Payouts are sent manually via Venmo, typically within 10 days of completing a job.

2. Doing the work. You're responsible for showing up on time, completing each job to a professional standard, and letting us know right away if a booking has a problem.

3. Scheduling. TeenTastic Turf may reassign or cancel a job if it can't be completed as scheduled.

4. No guaranteed work. Signing up doesn't guarantee a minimum number of jobs or a minimum amount of income.

5. Leaving any time. You can stop working with TeenTastic Turf whenever you want, and TeenTastic Turf can remove your access whenever it needs to.

      Meet the Creator

      About the Creator

      Hi, I'm Arjun ObliPrabu — a high school student and the founder of TeenTastic Turf. What began as a genuine interest in lawn care and snow removal has grown into a year-round business I'm proud to run myself. My goal is simple: leave every property looking better than I found it, one job at a time.

      I take pride in showing up on time, doing the work right, and treating every yard with the same care I'd give my own.

      Thank you for trusting me with your property — I look forward to working with you.

        How it works

        User Guide

        Quick walkthroughs for customers and service providers.

        1. Browse services

        Head to the home page and see everything on offer — lawn mowing, leaf blowing, weed whacking, and winter services like snow plowing and shoveling.

        2. Create an account

        Sign up with your name and address — your City/State/ZIP are pre-filled to save you time, just adjust if needed.

        3. Pick a date and time

        Choose a service, then pick an available day and time slot from the calendar. Some services also ask for a yard size.

        4. Pay and you're booked

        Pay with Venmo or choose to pay in cash. You'll get an email confirming your booking, and we'll show up at the scheduled time.

        1. Apply to join

        Sign up with your name and Venmo username (that's how you'll get paid), and agree to the Terms and Conditions.

        2. Get approved, then browse jobs

        Once admin approves your account (you'll get an email either way), you can request any open job that fits your schedule.

        3. Do the job, mark it done

        Once admin approves your request, the job moves to "My active jobs." Show up, do the work, then tap Mark Completed.

        4. Get paid

        You keep 80% of every job's price, sent to you via Venmo, typically within 10 days of marking it complete.
